clues.it: Ugo era nella 9ª colonna e nella 1ª riga.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 9th column and in the 1st row.

clues.it: Giada era accanto a una grata.
clues.en: Giada was beside a floor grate.

clues.it: Dario era l'unica persona su una grata.
clues.en: Dario was the only person on a floor grate.

clues.it: Luca era nella 11ª colonna, nella 4ª riga e a ovest di Olga.
clues.en: Luca was in the 11th column, in the 4th row and west of Olga.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 7ª riga e in Serra.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 7th row and in the Greenhouse.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 8ª riga e da solo in Mensa.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 8th row and alone in the Mess Hall.

clues.it: Irene era accanto a un droide.
LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

steps.it: L'indizio di Ugo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Ugo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 9th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Luca lascia una sola casella libera: riga 4ª, colonna 11ª.
steps.en: Luca's own clue leaves a single free square: row 4th, column 11th.

steps.it: Incrociando l'indizio di Olga con quelli già usati resta una sola casella: riga 5ª, colonna 12ª.
steps.en: Cross-checking Olga's clue with the ones already used leaves a single square: row 5th, column 12th.

steps.it: Ugo può stare solo nella 1ª riga: escludendola, a Dario resta una sola casella: riga 3ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Ugo can only be in the 1st row: ruling it out leaves Dario a single square: row 3rd, column 3rd.

steps.en: The general clue “2 beside a flight seat” cannot add up without Bruno: they must be at row 6th, column 2nd.
